metadata.eval_name: Conway's Game of Life with Emojis

messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements Conway's Game of Life with advanced features.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders Conway's Game of Life on the provided canvas
- Uses emojis to represent cells with different emojis for different generations
- Includes famous patterns: Glider, Blinker, Gosper Gun, Pulsar (selectable via dropdown)
- Speed control slider (1-10 generations per second)
- Click-to-toggle cells for custom patterns
- "Randomize" and "Clear" buttons
- Aging system where cells change emojis based on survival time
- Death animation with fade-out effect
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function startGameOfLife(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const width=canvas.width;const height=canvas.height;const cellSize=20;const cols=Math.floor(width/cellSize);const rows=Math.floor(height/cellSize);const emojis=['🟢','🟡','🟠','🔴','⚫'];let speed=5;let lastUpdate=0;let running=true;const grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array.from({length:cols},()=>({alive:false,age:0,fade:0})));function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.font=cellSize*0.8+'px sans-serif';for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const cell=grid[y][x];if(cell.alive||cell.fade>0){let emoji=cell.alive?emojis[Math.min(cell.age,emojis.length-1)]:emojis[0];ctx.globalAlpha=cell.alive?1:cell.fade;ctx.fillText(emoji,x*cellSize+cellSize/2,y*cellSize+cellSize/2);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}}}}function countNeighbors(x,y){let count=0;for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){if(dx===0&&dy===0)continue;const nx=x+dx;const ny=y+dy;if(nx>=0&&nx<cols&&ny>=0&&ny<rows&&grid[ny][nx].alive)count++;}}return count;}function step(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const cell=grid[y][x];const neighbors=countNeighbors(x,y);if(cell.alive){if(neighbors<2||neighbors>3){cell.alive=false;cell.fade=1;cell.age=0;}else{cell.age++;}}else{if(neighbors===3){cell.alive=true;cell.age=0;cell.fade=0;}}}}for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const cell=grid[y][x];if(!cell.alive&&cell.fade>0){cell.fade-=0.1;if(cell.fade<0)cell.fade=0;}}}}function loop(timestamp){if(running){if(timestamp-lastUpdate>1000/speed){step();lastUpdate=timestamp;}draw();}requestAnimationFrame(loop);}function toggleCell(e){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();const mx=e.clientX-rect.left;const my=e.clientY-rect.top;const cx=Math.floor(mx/cellSize);const cy=Math.floor(my/cellSize);if(cx>=0&&cx<cols&&cy>=0&&cy<rows){const cell=grid[cy][cx];cell.alive=!cell.alive;cell.age=0;cell.fade=0;draw();}}function clearGrid(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x]={alive:false,age:0,fade:0;}}draw();}function randomize(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x].alive=Math.random()<0.3;grid[y][x].age=0;grid[y][x].fade=0;}draw();}const patterns={Glider:[[1,0],[2,1],[0,2],[1,2],[2,2]],Blinker:[[1,0],[1,1],[1,2]],GosperGun:[[1,5],[2,5],[1,6],[2,6],[11,5],[12,5],[11,6],[12,6],[11,7],[12,7],[13,4],[14,4],[13,8],[14,8],[15,5],[15,6],[15,7],[16,6],[21,3],[22,3],[21,4],[22,4],[21,5],[22,5],[23,2],[23,6],[25,1],[25,2],[25,6],[25,7],[35,3],[36,3],[35,4],[36,4]],Pulsar:[[2,0],[3,0],[4,0],[6,0],[7,0],[8,0],[0,2],[5,2],[7,2],[12,2],[0,3],[5,3],[7,3],[12,3],[0,4],[5,4],[7,4],[12,4],[2,5],[3,5],[,5],[6,5],[7,5],[8,5],[2,6],[3,6],[4,6],[6,6],[7,6],[8,6],[0,7],[5,7],[7,7],[12,7],[0,8],[5,8],[7,8],[12,8],[2,10],[3,10],[4,10],[6,10],[7,10],[8,10],[0,11],[5,11],[7,11],[12,11],[0,12],[5,12],[7,12],[12,12],[2,13],[3,13],[4,13],[6,13],[7,13],[8,13]]};function placePattern(name){clearGrid();const pat=patterns[name];if(!pat)return;const offsetX=Math.floor(cols/2)-5;const offsetY=Math.floor(rows/2)-5;for(const [dx,dy] of pat){const x=offsetX+dx;const y=offsetY+dy;if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows){grid[y][x].alive=true;grid[y][x].age=0;grid[y][x].fade=0;}}draw();}const ctrlDiv=document.createElement('div');ctrlDiv.style.marginTop='10px';const select=document.createElement('select');['Glider','Blinker','GosperGun','Pulsar'].forEach(n=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=n;o.textContent=n;select.appendChild(o);});select.addEventListener('change',e=>placePattern(e.target.value));ctrlDiv.appendChild(select);const speedLabel=document.createElement('label');speedLabel.textContent=' Speed:';ctrlDiv.appendChild(speedLabel);const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='1';speedSlider.max='10';speedSlider.value='5';speedSlider.addEventListener('input',e=>{speed=parseInt(e.target.value);});ctrlDiv.appendChild(speedSlider);const randBtn=document.createElement('button');randBtn.textContent='Randomize';randBtn.onclick=randomize;ctrlDiv.appendChild(randBtn);const clearBtn=document.createElement('button');clearBtn.textContent='Clear';clearBtn.onclick=clearGrid;ctrlDiv.appendChild(clearBtn);canvas.parentNode.insertBefore(ctrlDiv,canvas.nextSibling);canvas.addEventListener('click',toggleCell);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
